get.results

Source: R/get.results.R
get.results.Rd

Simplifies the access to the differential expression results table. When the object contains a protein annotation table (protein.info slot, see load.counts2 and add.protein.info), the annotation columns can be appended to the results.

get.results(
  DEprot.analyses.object,
  contrast = 1,
  protein.info.columns = "none",
  protein.info.prefix = NULL
)

Arguments

DEprot.analyses.object

An object of class DEprot.analyses.

contrast

Number indicating the position of the contrast to use for the plotting.

protein.info.columns

String vector indicating which columns of the protein.info slot should be appended to the results table. Two keywords are available: "none", to return the results alone, and "all", to append the whole annotation. Any other value is interpreted as the names of the columns to append. Ignored when no annotation is stored in the object. Default: "none".

protein.info.prefix

String to prepend to the names of the appended annotation columns (e.g., "info."), useful to distinguish them from the columns of the results. If NULL (default), the original names are kept and only the ones colliding with the results columns are made unique.

Value

A data frame.

See also

add.protein.info, load.counts2

Author

Sebastian Gregoricchio

Examples

# Results alone
get.results(DEprot.analyses.object = DEprot::test.toolbox$diff.exp.limma,
            contrast = 1)
